name: andrewchay-gravitas-skills
description: Andrew Chay's personal skill marketplace for Gravitas / Claude Code — writing style, productivity and domain skills

plugins.name: ste-writing
plugins.description: ASD-STE100 simplified writing + anti-AI-style rewriter. Based on ASD-STE100 Issue 9 (2025-01-15) core writing rules with a 12-point anti-AI-style checklist. Three modes: rewrite (zero information loss), write (BLUF drafting with self-check), audit (rule-by-row diagnosis). Works for both English and Chinese output.

plugins.name: asd-ste100
plugins.description: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules repurposed for rewriting agent-facing English — tool descriptions, error messages, inter-agent instructions, system prompts — so it cannot be misparsed. Strict / STE-flavored modes, before-after examples, and a Python linter. Vendored from danyuchn/asd-ste100-skill (MIT, v0.4.0).

plugins.name: client-need-distillation
plugins.description: Distills fragmented client communications (meeting speednotes, chat logs) into shippable, high-ROI AI pilot scenarios. Seven-stage loop: evidence audit → scenario cards → scenario map → client-first lens (service outcomes as primary metrics, internal FTE/hours demoted to secondary economics) → net-new services scan → N-role thought experiment (restructure the org into a client-facing agent network) → one-week quick win with execution card. Built from a real FDE engagement with a hazardous-chemical logistics company; works for any B2B AI-transformation discovery.

plugins.name: huashu-nuwa
plugins.description: 女娲造人：输入人名/主题/甚至只是模糊需求，自动深度调研 → 思维框架提炼 → 生成可运行的人物 Skill。两种入口：明确人名直接蒸馏；模糊需求先诊断推荐再蒸馏。Vendored from alchaincyf/nuwa-skill (MIT).

plugins.name: huashu-art-motion
plugins.description: 艺术与视频动画：拆解复刻动画；代码画 35 种艺术风格并让画活；9 种解说动画语法，8 种可按口播参数渲片段；含口播整片参考代码及框景检查；人用 AI 生帧；可选已有录音、系统声音与语音复刻。Vendored from alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion (MIT).

plugins.name: huashu-design
plugins.description: 花叔 Design：用 HTML 做高保真原型、幻灯片、动画、可视化与专家评审。任何新设计 100% 先出三个方向初稿给用户选（指定风格/品牌也不豁免），选定后才执行。触发词：做原型、PPT、幻灯片、动画、设计风格、评审、HTML 页面、UI mockup、导出 MP4/GIF。生产级 Web App / 需后端的系统不适用。Vendored from alchaincyf/huashu-design (MIT).
